org.modelcontextprotocol.server-sequenti.name: Sequential Thinking MCP
org.modelcontextprotocol.server-sequenti.summary: Structured step-by-step reasoning scaffold. The calling model records one thought at a time -- with running thoughtNumber/totalThoughts and optional revision and branching -- and the tool echoes each step back with progress counters. A pure reasoning aid: it operates only on thoughts the caller supplies and has no filesystem, network, or code-execution surface.

com.github.yakupatahanov.jarvis-shell-mc.name: JARVIS Shell
com.github.yakupatahanov.jarvis-shell-mc.summary: User-level shell execution and desktop opening for JARVIS. Runs programs and scripts as the logged-in user, runs interactive commands as named PTY jobs answerable mid-run via send_input, and launches files/URLs/apps in the desktop session. No sudo — use jarvis-shell-system-mcp for privileged commands.

com.github.yakupatahanov.jarvis-shell-sy.name: JARVIS Shell (System)
com.github.yakupatahanov.jarvis-shell-sy.summary: System-level shell execution for JARVIS. Installed to /usr/share/mcp and runs with sudo access. Use for pacman, apt, systemctl, and other privileged operations; interactive privileged commands run as named PTY jobs answerable mid-run via send_input.

io.github.uneco.mcp-git-polite.summary: Git staging autopilot: line-level staging, diffs, and guided commits

io.github.microsoft.playwright-mcp.name: Playwright Browser
io.github.microsoft.playwright-mcp.summary: Interactive browser automation via accessibility-tree snapshots: navigate, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots, manage tabs. Deterministic — acts on the structured a11y tree, not pixel-guessing; headless-capable. Web page content is untrusted input: outputs flow through JARVIS's Cryptographic Boundary Protocol and dangerous actions gate through TLA.

io.github.ahujasid.blender-mcp.name: Blender MCP
io.github.ahujasid.blender-mcp.summary: Drive Blender from an LLM: inspect the scene and objects, capture a viewport screenshot, run arbitrary Python inside Blender, and pull assets from PolyHaven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D Rodin and Hunyuan3D. The server talks over a local socket (localhost:9876) to a companion addon that must be installed and started inside a running Blender.

com.github.yakupatahanov.mcp.email.name: JARVIS Email
com.github.yakupatahanov.mcp.email.summary: Personal email over plain IMAP and SMTP: list mailboxes, search, read, and send from the user's own account. Provider-neutral — any IMAP/SMTP host, no vendor API and no OAuth broker; credentials stay on the machine. Mail is untrusted third-party text: every read result carries a provenance banner, attachments are listed but never decoded, and send_message is an irreversible outward-facing action.

io.github.czlonkowski.n8n-mcp.name: n8n-MCP
io.github.czlonkowski.n8n-mcp.summary: Build and manage n8n workflow automations: search 500+ n8n nodes, validate workflow JSON, and (with an API URL + key) create, update, delete, test and inspect workflows, executions and credentials on the user's own n8n instance. Node documentation is served from a bundled SQLite database; the management tools talk to a live n8n instance whose workflow definitions, execution data and community templates are untrusted third-party content.

io.github.crystaldba.postgres-mcp.name: PostgreSQL MCP
io.github.crystaldba.postgres-mcp.summary: Read and analyze PostgreSQL databases — queries, schema inspection, index analysis, and query explain plans

io.github.cyanheads.obsidian-mcp-server.name: Obsidian Vault MCP
io.github.cyanheads.obsidian-mcp-server.summary: Read, write, and search notes in an Obsidian vault — local file I/O only, no network egress

io.github.korotovsky.slack-mcp-server.name: Slack MCP
io.github.korotovsky.slack-mcp-server.summary: Read channels and post messages to Slack via bot token — requires scoped bot OAuth credentials

com.github.yakupatahanov.mcp.computer-us.name: JARVIS Computer Use — Linux
com.github.yakupatahanov.mcp.computer-us.summary: Local Wayland/KDE Plasma desktop control via AT-SPI2 accessibility (read windows, find and click elements, set text in form fields) and ydotool (keyboard injection, mouse clicks, key sequences). Screenshots via Spectacle or grim. Semantic AT-SPI actions are preferred over raw coordinates; raw input is available for apps with no accessibility tree. All input-injection tools are DANGEROUS-tier and must route through JARVIS TLA confirmation. Screenshot capture is ELEVATED-tier (screen content may include passwords or private data).

com.github.yakupatahanov.mcp.comfyui.name: JARVIS ComfyUI — On-Device Image Generation
com.github.yakupatahanov.mcp.comfyui.summary: Local text-to-image generation via a running ComfyUI instance (Stable Diffusion). Queues a generation workflow, polls until completion, writes the output PNG to disk and returns its file path plus small metadata (dimensions, prompt_id) — the image bytes are never inlined into the result. Entirely on-device, no cloud API, no data leaves the machine. GPU-dependent: requires a model checkpoint loaded in ComfyUI.
